name: Oda Mako
source:
Area: Aichi Prefecture

A rich girl who takes walks around the city with her lolita clothes and parasol. Mako has a weird habit of explaining the meaning of every character in her name when she introduces herself. She also easily gets distracted and if she gets bored of a conversation, her eyes and mind easily shift to the next interesting thing.
